summary.text: PCTG is a glycol-modified polycyclohexylenedimethylene terephthalate. A maker sells it for packaging, electronic housings and biomedical applications, and makers describe low shrinkage and high dimensional stability. Its HDT at 0.45 MPa is 76 °C, below its glass transition. On the H2C it prints at 250⁠–⁠270 °C without chamber heat, and makers advise pre-drying, a maker calling it moderately hygroscopic.
